canonical_project: Hana Financial Town Cheongna Group Integrated Data Center
notes: IFEZ documented completion of Hana Financial Group's integrated data center in Cheongna International City on June 20, 2017, integrating IT infrastructure for 13 financial affiliates. Hana TI history confirms construction completion, authorization for use and IT system transfer to the Cheongna Group Integrated Data Center in 2017. Public MW capacity was not found.
